messages.text: What is the cheapest raised relief globe?

The most affordable raised relief option right now is the 12-inch Blue Ocean Desk Globe - French Language Edition with Raised Relief at $74.00 — great tactile mountain ranges, just with French place names. If you want English labels, the Globemaster 12" Blue Ocean Desk Globe with Raised Relief is just a bit more at $79.00 and is a favorite for its budget-friendly quality. Either one you'll find by name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
